hook: A plant line stops. A server stops answering. And every minute, production waits.
stat1: Fifty-seven percent of operators said their most recent major outage cost more than a hundred thousand dollars.
stat2: And one in five said it cost more than a million.
intro: Here is how Mova iO brings a hung server back, before the shift notices.
s1: Seven thirty-eight. In Ops Ramp, the M E S application server for line two stops answering. The app check fails, the agent heartbeat is lost, and ping drops to zero.
s2: Mova iO's event correlator groups five alerts and two calls from the plant into one inference, flags the root-cause alert, and opens one incident in ServiceNow.
s3: The triage orchestrator checks v Center. The host is healthy, the storage is fine, and other servers on the same network respond. But this V M has been pinned at a hundred percent C P U, with memory at ninety-eight, and VMware Tools has stopped.
s4: So the incident arrives already diagnosed: a guest O S hang, at ninety-two percent confidence, with everything it ruled out, and a recommended runbook.
s5: Because this is a production system, Plant I T approves the fix in Microsoft Teams: take a memory snapshot first, then reset the V M.
s6: In Copilot Studio, every step is a tool call you can inspect: the V M health check, the runbook search, the approval, the Key Vault secret, the snapshot, and the reset, with exact inputs and outputs.
s7: In v Center, the snapshot completes, and the reset follows. VMware Tools is running again, C P U settles at eighteen percent, and the application check comes back green.
s8: The plant channel gets a plain update. In ServiceNow, the incident is resolved, and because this is the third hang this month, a problem record is raised, with the memory dump attached for the vendor.
close: Hang diagnosed in under two minutes. Line two back six minutes after the first alert. Evidence kept, and a problem raised, so it doesn't come back.
tag: Hung servers, recovered by Mova iO agents. With people in control.
end: Movate. Your applied A I partner.
